source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Software Maintenance and Updates (PDF 124, printed 120).

blocks.text: Software maintenance (dekh-bhaal) ka matlab hai programs aur applications ko baqaida update kar ke achhi halat mein rakhna. Updates aksar errors theek karte hain, performance behtar karte hain aur naye features dalte hain jo software ko zyada mehfooz banate hain. Talaba seekhte hain ke software companies updates is liye jari karti hain ta ke woh security gaps (hifazat ke soorakh) band hon jin se hackers faida utha sakte hain. Updates nazarandaz karne se system slow ho sakta hai, crash ho sakta hai ya data chori ho sakta hai. Baqaida maintenance computers ko bharosemand, tez aur cyber threats se mehfooz rakhti hai.

Jab software update nahi hota to woh hackers ka aasan nishana ban jata hai. Purane versions mein aise security holes ho sakte hain jo files ya zaati data tak unauthorized access (be-ijazat rasai) dete hain. Purana (outdated) software naye systems ya tools ke saath compatibility (mel na khane) ke masle bhi paida kar sakta hai. Aise programs use karne se malware infection aur data breach (data leak hona) ka khatra barhta hai. Software ko baqaida update karna yeh khatre kam karta hai aur system ko mehfooz aur bharosemand rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba updated aur outdated (purane) software ke features ka muwazna karein aur guftagu karein ke purane versions par hamla kaise ho sakta hai.
